message: ハッピーエンドの向こう側

name: Synn
message: 「Calm down, let's calm down, you gotta calm down, me.」
Lunch break. I wait for Nanaka in a corner of the old school building where people rarely come.
Just a moment ago, I pressed a 10-yen chocolate into Lolotte's hand as a tip and had her call Nanaka over.
Things between Misa and me are still awkward. Even so, I can't let these feelings drag on forever. I'm the Student Council President, so I have to pull myself together!
In the same way, Misa, as Vice President--

name: Synn
message: 「Even when Misa ran into difficult situations, she always tried to figure something out, and she always managed to pull through.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yet this time around, she just can't do it. If the President and Vice President are acting like this, there's no way the Holy Night Festival is gonna go well.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you understand that much, then you've got some kind of breakthrough plan, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, since it's Misa we're dealing with. As President and Vice President, I'm thinking of making a pact to separate emotion from reason right now.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's an impossible ask.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your behavioral patterns are built entirely on emotion, aren't they, Demon Lord? How the heck are you gonna build a rational decision-making circuit now?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know how, which is why I'm consulting Nanaka.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You dumbass! Soba is a walking bundle of emotion, isn't she?!」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But I don't have anyone else I can talk to about this, do I.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then spill everything to Soba and follow your emotions all the way through. Otherwise, Synn-sama won't be Synn-sama anymore!」

name: Synn
message: 「Not Demon Lord, just Synn, huh... Got it, thanks.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, you came.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, of course, I mean... Synn's going to c-conf... to me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for making you come all the way out here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, it's fine... The rooftop and the narrow path are lovely too, but... this place has a nice vibe as well.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you staring so straight at me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, why are you crouching down and covering your face with both hands?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Wait a second, I need to psych myself back up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bring it ooon!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, there's something I need to talk to you about, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I actually have something to tell you too, Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so you're worried about Misa too, Nanaka. That makes things easy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, why are you crouching down and covering your face with both hands again?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's nothing at all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm baaack! Hit me with it!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uh, can I go ahead?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just spit it out already!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, things have been super awkward between Misa and me in the Student Council and stuff, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, if anything, Misa's way more rattled than you are, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's actually my fault.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it's about all that Demon Lord blah-blah-blah stuff, I told Misa--」

name: Synn
message: 「I confessed to Misa.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N... No way...!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's true. The reason Misa and I are so on edge around each other has more to do with that than the Demon Lord stuff...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-How did it go?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha... I got dumped.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shot down? Did she turn you down properly?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I didn't get an answer, but the look on Misa's face back then...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm the one making Misa suffer. Yet as the root cause, I have no idea what to do.」

name: Synn
message: 「So, selfish as it is, rather than letting our relationship stay like this any longer, I'm going to give up on Misa completely.」

name: Synn
message: 「And I want to patch things up so we go back to how we used to be.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, when did you confess?」

name: Synn
message: 「On oden day... the night my secret about being the Demon Lord got exposed. Things have been awkward between us ever since.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Which means...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So that's why Misa...!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Yeah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「L-Leave it to me!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're childhood friends, aren't we?! Don't act so distant with me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll take care of things with Misa, so you go all-out with your Demon Lord training, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Thanks. Opening up to you was definitely the right call, Nanaka.」

name: Synn
message: 「See ya! Sorry for calling you out here only to leave, but I'm gonna take a quick nap in the Student Council room. Got tough magic training again today.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, rest up. I'll shake you awake when the warning bell rings.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Honestly, Synn has no clue how I feel...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ta-da♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, that's just the weakness that comes with falling in love, isn't it~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-Why are you here, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Never mind me, what are you gonna do now~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's obvious! I hate leaving things all hazy and unresolved!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「First, I've gotta have a talk with that blockheaded, fox-brained good-for-nothing!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Why do you always put your love rival ahead of yourself~? You could've just confessed right here and now~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way! That'd feel like cheating!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, yeah~. That's what I like about you, Nana-chan~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bohoho... Well, I hate it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, my chances aren't zero either!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh, youth! I'm jealous~ Look at you go, you gutsy Nana-chan~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You oughta enjoy your youth too, Sacchin. You're actually pretty cute when you keep quiet and stay still.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No, no. Just watching you is more than enough to fill me up, Nana-chan~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Watching is fine, I guess... Wait, more importantly, what were you even doing in a place like this, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm so glad you asked~ Ehehehe~, I was developing a brand-new headbutt~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I shouldn't have asked...」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh my...?」
At the sudden change in the feel and sound of the ground beneath my soles, I stop in my tracks.
No, it wasn't sudden. I'd already been walking nonstop for quite a long time. By now, Nanaka-san must surely be confessing to Sakura-kun.
So that I wouldn't get in the way--making that excuse to myself, I left the academy, and before I knew it, I had ended up here.
Was I unconsciously seeking Shio... seeking the warmth of family?

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, are you here?」
Unusually enough, on the shrine grounds, Shio and Riesling-san were standing close together, facing one another.

name: Riesling
message: 「Hah!」

name: Shio
message: 「Eek!」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa!? Riesling-san just hit Shio!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「No, I stopped just short of making contact.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's true I didn't hear anything hit, though...」
It didn't seem like a fight or a quarrel had broken out.
Riesling's fist had been thrust toward Shio's face, stopping dead just before touching the bridge of his nose.

name: Shio
message: 「How careless of me, to shut my eyes once again!」

name: Riesling
message: 「That is a completely normal reaction.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What are you doing?」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, if it isn't Sister. I am currently receiving instruction in martial techniques from Sir Jeeves.」

name: Shio
message: 「It is training to keep one's eyes open and track an enemy's movements even when an attack comes right at one's nose. Truly the secret art of a master!」

name: Riesling
message: 「No, it is the most basic of basics.」

name: Misa
message: 「Are you training your dynamic visual acuity?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Speaking purely in terms of physical function, that is corre--hmph.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ugh.」

name: Misa
message: 「You closed your eyes.」

name: Shio
message: 「I did not close them!」

name: Shio
message: 「Guh, hih, fuh!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're definitely closing your eyes, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「N-Nay. Decidedly nay.」

name: Shio
message: 「It may have looked as though they were shut, yet in truth I had them cracked open ever so slightly.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hah!」

name: Shio
message: 「Hyah.」

name: Shio
message: 「Guh... H-How pathetic. Not only did I shut my eyes, I even stepped back half a pace.」

name: Riesling
message: 「There is no need to feel ashamed. It is only natural for a human being.」

name: Shio
message: 「Yet when Sir Jeeves faced my naginata, he stood firm as a guardian deity with both eyes wide open!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Anyone can do it, depending on their mindset.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lady Shio, do not rush things right now... Just please, do not run away.」

name: Riesling
message: 「If you continue to hold the courage to stand your ground, the path before you will eventually open up.」
My chest unexpectedly aches.
Could Riesling-san actually be saying that to me?

name: Shio
message: 「Jiiya-dono...」

name: Shio
message: 「Might I be permitted to call you Big Sister...?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Shio. Are you misunderstanding something again?」

name: Shio
message: 「Every time Big Sister Riesling's hand draws near, my heart pounds fiercely. C-Could this, perchance, be... love?\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, that pounding heart and feeling of liking her is just the suspension bridge effect playing tricks on you. Wake up!」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-Yes... First love truly is wonderful, isn't it...\s04」

name: Shio
message: 「N-Now then! Let us take a brief recess. I shall go prepare some tea. Pray wait just a moment.」

name: Shio
message: 「Thank you for waiting.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh? Today's tea accompaniment is pickled vegetables, isn't it?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed, I received these pickles from Lord Akane. Please, do enjoy them.」
Sitting on the edge of the worship hall's veranda, I drink some tea.

name: Misa
message: 「Mm, delicious...」
Truth is, my mind is swirling so much I can't even taste it. I want Shio to listen to me talk about Sakura-kun, yet I have no idea how to bring it up...

name: Shio
message: 「...Elder Sister, did you happen to have a quarrel with Synn-dono?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's with that out of nowhere?!」

name: Shio
message: 「This is the very first time I have ever seen you tell a lie during tea time, Elder Sister?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ghh!!」

name: Misa
message: 「...W-We didn't have a fight. Really.」

name: Shio
message: 「Is that so? For quite some time now, I have not seen the two of you together.」

name: Shio
message: 「I am quite fond of seeing you and Synn-dono pushing each other to improve and striving for greater heights, Elder Sister. Thus, I feel a tad lonely.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio...」

name: Misa
message: 「Have you ever fallen in love with the same person as a close friend?」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I-I am utterly unversed in such romantic affairs, so I scarcely know how I ought to answer...」

name: Shio
message: 「However, even without asking me, do you not have your beloved romance novels, Sister?」

name: Misa
message: 「In reality, things don't go as smoothly as they do in novels...」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is just as you say.」

name: Riesling
message: 「The prince and the princess were united. A happy ending.」

name: Riesling
message: 「A novel ends there, yet reality continues onward...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Compared to the time the two have lived thus far, they will spend long years together that feel akin to eternity.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Perhaps they may part ways. Perhaps they will not be blessed with children, and will be tormented by loneliness.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yet conversely, by sharing those years together, their bond may deepen, and they may become a happy family.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Does that mean there are many paths we can take forward?」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is just as you say.」

name: Riesling
message: 「...The structure of Re-Crea is far simpler compared to the human heart. Please keep your eyes firmly fixed on what is truly important, without losing sight of it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, thank you very much!」
